blockers: No authorized existing CUDOS provider credential source was found in the documented disposable configurations, current shell, known historical project env paths, standard OpenWork env store, or standard OpenCode auth/config stores. Only file presence, provider IDs and key names/presence were reported; no key values were printed.

Supply an exact existing owner-only env-file path securely. Do not paste secrets into chat, command arguments, Git, or a report. The launcher reads only CUDOS_API_KEY and allowlisted CUDOS policy metadata; it never executes env-file contents.
Credential presence is not credential validity. Actual provider model-catalog access and inference must still pass.

Verified-only provider policy is retained. Account-specific training/retention policy evidence must be supplied by the operator if absent; no verification date, zero-retention claim, or account opt-in state was invented.

Final launcher retains manual host approval. Any required approval must follow the actual supported approval flow, not a host-token bypass. Normal-user five-desk acceptance is not established by startup.
The local email preview is a console-delivery fixture using public signup/verification routes, not a real inbox. No accounts were seeded, marked verified, or created during wiring checks.
